column11:
The user may swap between the following subweapons, each with respective effects:
 - Gladius: +1 dice on the user's attacks,
 - Scutum: attacks from range against the user lose 5 damage,
 - Pilum: Melee attacks gain +3 range.
As a Standard action, the user may swap to any subweapon. Swapping due to a move effect occurs regardless of hit or miss. The user starts the game in Gladius.
If in Gladius, swap to Scutum. If in Scutum, this has Push 3 and swap to Pilum. If in Pilum, this inflicts 4 Cripple/1 and swap to Gladius.

If used in Gladius, this attack inflicts -2d6 DEF/1 and has Push 1. If used in Scutum, the user takes half damage from AoE attacks for one round and is pushed back one tile. The user switches to Pilum.
The user must be in Pilum to use this move. This attack has +1 base dice and Pull 4 against targets over 4 tiles away. The user switches to either Gladius or Scutum.

The user switches to either Gladius or Scutum. If Gladius, for one round, foes who enter the user's melee take 3d8 damage. If Scutum, for one round, the user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have their DEF ignored. The user must switch subweapons.

If in Scutum, this may be used on a foe hitting the user or an ally in the user's melee. If the target is in melee, this has +1 dice and the user swaps to Gladius. Else, swap to Pilum. This ignores outside factors, does not add ATK/MAG, and ignores half DEF.

The user must be in either Gladius or Pilum to use this move. The user switches to Scutum and for one round, the flat modifier in base rolls on attacks targeting the user become negative. This may be used as a non-damaging Standard.

Subweapons are "used" when the user uses a weapon attack or weapon standard in it. 
The user's next attack this turn in a subweapon with fewer uses than both others gains +1 dice. If it has 2+ fewer uses than both others, it also gains +2 ACC.
If used in Scutum, before accuracy, for one round, the user cannot be affected by any status or debuff and has any such effect removed.

This move grants a different bonus based on the user's subweapon.
Gladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC and CR/1.

This must be used before the user moves. The user's MP is halved and they choose an additional subweapon to wield until the start of their next turn. Only the user's original subweapon is considered for subweapon swapping.

This move has a different range and effect depending on the user's subweapon(s).
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, and this attack has +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, and for one round, attacks targeting the user are immune to positive outside factors to accuracy and damage.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, and has -3 MR.
If Dual Wield is active, the user picks one range and one effect from the subweapons.

If in Pilum, steal targets' buffs and set their duration to one round. Switch to Scutum.
If in Scutum, this becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius. 
If in Gladius, gain +1 MP/1 and lower other cooldowns by one round. Switch to Pilum.

Each subweapon gains additional passive bonuses:
Gladius: +0.5X dice, Scutum: +X DEF, Pilum: +0.5X ACC
X is equal to the amount of times the user has used their least used subweapon.

If, in the last round, a foe's ability moved or attempted to move the user, this ability has +2 dice and becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Select an unoccupied tile in range, ignoring range reduction. The user teleports to this tile (even on miss) and targets foes (including Ice/Stone) in its Splash. If no foes are targetted, this is not an attack.

When the user misses a Standard/Full attack, any buffs that attack would benefit from are applied to the user's next Standard/Full attack, which also gains +2 ACC, 10% of the damage the missed attack would have dealt, and ignores 5 DEF.

The target of the user's next single-target attack is the Duel Partner for two rounds or until the user or target dies or the user damages another foe. The user deals and takes 30 less damage from all foes except their DP. If the DP has allies or is a monster, this value is reduced to 5.

The user chooses the status inflicted if its conditions are met. This attack also gains -2 MR (if Poison), +2 dice (if Confusion), or heals the user 5 HP (if Bleed).
5 Poison/2: If the user's accuracy modifier is negative or the target has increased EVA.
Confusion/2: If the target's accuracy modifiers caused them to hit an attack or trigger an effect they otherwise would not have on the user or their allies.
6 Bleed/2: If the target has critical hit or had +dice on an attack on the user and allies.
Targets are inflicted with -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If the user is debuffed by foes, they are cleansed before accuracy, this attack gains a hit, and the debuff inflicted is doubled.

If, in the last round, the target gained more than 5 DEF, HP or Shield, this attack has advantage damage dice. The user gains 75% of the DEF, HP or Shield (whichever is highest) that the target recieved in this time as Shield/1.

This may be used on a foe that statuses the user or targets them outside Range 4. The user teleports to an unoccupied tile in their Melee (even on miss) and gains +2 ACC and +5 DMG to their next Standard/Full attack. This attack ignores outside damage factors.

If the target dealt 50+ damage to the user in the last round, this attack gains +3 dice. If 75+, this attack also gains +4 dice faces. This attack has -1 MR per attack that hit the user since their last turn, inflicting Confusion/2 when MR<4.

Adaptive's numerical bonuses are tripled. On the user's turns, they gain 5X Shield and their attacks gain +5X% damage, where X = the number of times they were targetted by foes' abilities since their last turn.

The user moves up to their MP+1, treating all tiles except the final as Normal. For the rest of the turn, the user's attacks ignore obstructions and DEF and invert foe's negative numerical outside damage factors.
